versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Error Message Writer skill.
- Generates clear, blame-free error messages for users, focusing on plain language and actionable next steps.
- Provides message variants by surface (inline, toast, full page) and accommodates custom tone or length requirements.
- Separates technical details for logging from what is shown to users.
- Includes guidance for required inputs, quality checks, and anti-patterns to ensure high-quality error copy.
